newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr unchanged against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr unchanged against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr remained unchanged against the dollar for the third consecutive week, the central National Bank of Ethiopia said on Monday.
The central bank said after the currency auction on December 7, the applicable rate for all deals outside the auction in the period December 9 to December 15 would be 6.38 to the dollar.

The central bank also quoted the birr against the pound at a mean rate of 10.4884 from 10.3930 last week. On the yen, the birr traded at 0.056419 from 0.056675 and at 4.1149 against the mark from 4.0939 last week.
